title: ANP Health
description: anphealthsolutions.com ANP Health Services Inc. is a Florida-based recruitment agency specializing in placing foreign-trained nurses into U.S. hospitals, with a strong focus on Latin America (especially Venezuela). Founded in 2019 by Nelson Hurtado, a Venezuelan immigrant and registered nurse, the company provides an end-to-end service: credential validation, NCLEX exam preparation, English training, direct-hire placement with 150+ partner hospitals, and visa sponsorship (EB-3 Green Card for the nurse and family). It has helped over 2,000 nurses from 28 countries, with candidates typically earning $70–100K per year plus sign-on bonuses. The company is a Certified Ethical Recruiter (CGFNS Alliance) — one of only about 16 accredited firms in the U.S. — and employs roughly 30–50 people across 9 countries. Estimated revenue is $10–50 million annually.
